en: Projects can now be renamed using the pencil button in the sidebar. Display names are saved in app settings and shared by conversations in the same project; working folders stay unchanged.
Adjusted sidebar typography so Pinned, Projects, Recent and project names are larger than conversation titles.
zh: 项目名称旁加入铅笔按钮，可直接修改、保存或取消。显示名称保存在应用设置中，同一项目的会话共用该名称，工作目录保持原样。
调整侧栏字号层级：置顶、项目、最近及项目名称更大，会话名称更小。
